Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Adoption: Move the sign_in screen to occur after pet adoption screens so users build emotional connection before account creation. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion and sign_in drops 27.1%; letting users create their pet first increases sign-in motivation.)
1: [home, redesign] Interactive Desktop Waiting Room: Redesign waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout with interactive previews and desktop control tips while loading. (why: The waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support receives tickets about pets missing on desktop after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Status Bar and Background Ready Alert: Add a visual progress bar and a desktop notification switch during pet rendering on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, leading users to believe the pet failed to launch or open.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Photo Quality Guide & Companion Preview: Add photo quality tips and live pet style preview to the photo upload step to prevent rendering errors. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)

scores.note: Moving sign-in post-adoption leverages emotional attachment to reduce early drop-off.
Interactive waiting room addresses extreme wait times and missing pet support tickets.
Visual progress bar and alerts clarify long background render times to prevent drop-off.
Photo quality tips and previews target the step with the highest funnel drop-off (39.1%).
